Simplified text: Definitions in Aadhaar Act, 2016
In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) "Aadhaar number" means an identification number issued to an individual under section 3(3), including any alternative virtual identity generated under section 3(4).
(aa) "Aadhaar ecosystem" includes enrolling agencies, Registrars, requesting entities, offline verification-seeking entities, and any other specified entities.
(b) "Aadhaar number holder" means an individual who has been issued an Aadhaar number under this Act.
(ba) "Adjudicating Officer" means an officer appointed under section 33B.
(bb) "Appellate Tribunal" means the tribunal referred to in section 33C.
(c) "authentication" means the process of submitting an individual's Aadhaar number along with demographic or biometric information for verification by the Central Identities Data Repository.
(d) "authentication record" means the record of the time of authentication, the identity of the requesting entity, and the response provided by the Authority.
(e) "Authority" means the Unique Identification Authority of India established under section 11.
(f) "benefit" means any advantage, gift, reward, relief, or payment provided to an individual or group of individuals, as notified by the Central Government.
(g) "biometric information" means photograph, fingerprint, iris scan, or other specified biological attributes.
(h) "Central Identities Data Repository" means a centralized database containing all Aadhaar numbers issued, demographic and biometric information, and related data.
(i) "Chairperson" means the Chairperson of the Authority appointed under section 12.
(ia) "child" means a person under eighteen years of age.
(j) "core biometric information" means fingerprint, iris scan, or other specified biological attributes.
(k) "demographic information" includes information related to name, date of birth, address, and other relevant details, as specified by regulations.
(l) "enrolling agency" means an agency appointed for collecting demographic and biometric information under this Act.
(m) "enrolment" means the process to collect demographic and biometric information from individuals for issuing Aadhaar numbers.
(n) "identity information" includes Aadhaar number, biometric information, and demographic information.
(o) "Member" includes the Chairperson and Members of the Authority.
(p) "notification" means a notification published in the Official Gazette.
(pa) "offline verification" means the process of verifying the identity of an Aadhaar number holder without authentication, through specified offline modes.
(pb) "offline verification-seeking entity" means any entity desiring offline verification of an Aadhaar number holder.
(q) "prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Act.
(r) "records of entitlement" means records of benefits, subsidies, or services provided to or availed by any individual under any program.
(s) "Registrar" means any entity authorized for enrolling individuals under this Act.
(t) "regulations" means the regulations made by the Authority under this Act.
(u) "requesting entity" means an agency or person submitting Aadhaar number, demographic information, or biometric information for authentication.
(v) "resident" means an individual who has resided in India for a specified period preceding the date of enrollment.
(w) "service" means any provision, facility, utility, or assistance provided to an individual or group of individuals, as notified by the Central Government.
(x) "subsidy" means any form of aid, support, grant, or appropriation in cash or kind provided to an individual or group of individuals, as notified by the Central Government.
(Note: Some sections and dates have been mentioned in regards to amendments made to the Act.)

SECTION 3 of Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016
The Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016
Chapter II
Enrolment
3. Aadhaar number.-
(1) Every resident shall be entitled to obtain an Aadhaar number by submitting his demographic information and biometric information by undergoing the process of enrolment:
Provided that the Central Government may, from time to time, notify such other category of individuals who may be entitled to obtain an Aadhaar number.
(2) The enrolling agency shall, at the time of enrolment, inform the individual undergoing enrolment of the following details in such manner as may be specified by regulations, namely:-
(a) the manner in which the information shall be used;
(b) the nature of recipients with whom the information is intended to be shared during authentication; and
(c) the existence of a right to access information, the procedure for making requests for such access, and details of the person or department in-charge to whom such requests can be made.
(3) On receipt of the demographic information and biometric information under sub-section (1), the Authority shall, after verifying the information, in such manner as may be specified by regulations, issue an Aadhaar number to such individual.
1[(4) The Aadhaar number issued to an individual under sub-section (3) shall be a twelve-digit identification number and any alternative virtual identity as an alternative to the actual Aadhaar number of an individual that shall be generated by the Authority in such manner as may be specified by regulations.]
1. Ins. by Act 14 of 2019, s. 4 (w.e.f. 25-7-2019).

Entitlement to Aadhaar Number:
Every resident has the right to get an Aadhaar number by providing their demographic and biometric information during the enrollment process. The Central Government may also identify other groups of individuals who are entitled to obtain an Aadhaar number.


Details Provided During Enrollment:
The enrolling agency must inform the individual being enrolled about the following details:
- How the information will be used
- The recipients with whom the information will be shared for authentication
- The right to access the information, the process for making access requests, and the contact details for the person or department in charge of handling such requests.


Aadhaar Number Issuance:
Upon receiving the demographic and biometric information, the Authority will verify the information and issue a twelve-digit Aadhaar number to the individual. Additionally, an alternative virtual identity may be generated as specified by regulations.
